replies.author: hasl
replies.body: 1-hit maps were removed, because 75% of the kills are ping based and the map is slightly too big for that game style. I have to admit Zao was one of my favourite team-deathmatch maps by a long way, but I got bored when the hit registration on Avicus broke(???) and I can only get kills with the bow or surprise attack. You could ask for 2 hit kills maybe, but Zao will never be the same without the Sharpness X. :(
